ValidationRule.description: Validation Rule to throw an error message When a Car Colors Available is changed from Red, Black, Green, Grey to White.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( Car_Colors_Available__c ), NOT(ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Car_Colors_Available__c ),'White')), ISPICKVAL( Car_Colors_Available__c ,'White') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You Can't Change Your Color To white.
